rationale.edition: both — the changed paths span both repos: web/src/** and src/api/management/** are OSS-owned locations, while o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/anomaly_detection/** (plus o2_enterprise/tests/**) are enterprise-owned. The enterprise anomaly_detection module and its keywords corroborate the ENT half, but the UI and API surface lives in OSS paths, so the change is a linked OSS+ENT pair.
rationale.skip: no skip — the change is user-facing: it alters the alerts anomaly-detection UI (AnomalyDetectionConfig.vue, AlertConfigSummary.vue, AnomalyDetectionChart.vue) under web/src. No skip label or comment was provided (trigger_comment.txt is empty) and the diff is not docs/CI-only, so no opt-out or no-user-facing-change condition applies.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted — the diff introduces and alters a user-exercisable anomaly-detection configuration flow (percentile sensitivity tier vs per-day alert budget modes) and changes the sensitivity hint text/copy in the alerts UI; those are interactive UI behaviors a browser test should verify.
rationale.area: Alerts — the UI changes live in web/src/components/alerts and web/src/components/anomaly_detection (the alert add/edit flow), and the existing E2E spec sits under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts/, matching that product area.
rationale.group: Alerts — ci_matrix_env.json defines an Alerts shard (actual_folder Alerts), and the enterprise overlay ci_matrix.ent.json already appends alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js to that same Alerts shard, so the spec belongs there.
rationale.existing_tests: the diff modifies tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts/alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js — a genuine Playwright E2E spec — so E2E coverage already exists in the diff and the Architect should enhance/extend it to cover the new percentile-vs-budget threshold semantics and the updated hint assertions. The many *.spec.ts files under web/src/** are Vitest unit tests and do not count as E2E coverage.
